about_title: From the field to the digital world, the same standard.
about_text: Passionate about digital from the start, I've spent 3 years helping entrepreneurs and small businesses across West Africa with their digital transformation — website creation, digital marketing and business strategy. With strong skills in project management, leadership and team management, I run my own ventures (Digit Communication, Gratias Agrobusiness Center) while training professionals in practical English through Winner English Club. Curious and always learning, I keep expanding my skills to better serve my clients.
about_quote: Combining technical expertise, strategic vision and teaching to help people exist online and communicate without borders.
